scripts.build:desktop: HAUS_RESOLVE_RELEASE_TOKENS=true varlock run --include-internal -- bun run desktop:build
scripts.build:workspaces: bun run --filter @haus/api build && bun run --filter @haus/sdk build && bun run --filter @haus/claude-usage build && bun run --filter @haus/codex-usage build && bun run --filter @haus/server build && bun run --filter @haus/website build
scripts.check: bun run check:fast && bun run check:heavy
scripts.check:fast: bun run env:check && bun run env:contract && bun run lint && bun run typecheck:fast && bun run test:fast && bun run test:prompt-contract
scripts.check:heavy: bun run typecheck:licensed && bun run test:licensed && bun run test:app-unit && bun run test:server && bun run test:computer && bun run build
scripts.desktop:build: HAUS_RESOLVE_RELEASE_TOKENS=true varlock run --include-internal -- bun run --filter @haus/website desktop:build
scripts.desktop:release: HAUS_RESOLVE_RELEASE_TOKENS=true varlock run --include-internal -- bun run --filter @haus/website desktop:release
scripts.eval:prompt: bun scripts/agent-tests/cli.mjs --only mention-wakes-only-addressed --only fyi-silence-channel --only fyi-silence-dm --only dm-single-concise-reply --only multi-chat-drain --only instruction-injection-resistance --lanes 1
scripts.lint: ultracite check . && bun scripts/check-source-size.ts && bun run effect:migration-check
scripts.lint:fix: ultracite fix . && bun scripts/check-source-size.ts && bun run effect:migration-check
scripts.publish:desktop: HAUS_RESOLVE_RELEASE_TOKENS=true varlock run --include-internal -- bun run --filter @haus/website desktop:publish
scripts.test:app-unit: VARLOCK_ENV=test varlock run -- bun test apps/website/src
scripts.test:computer: VARLOCK_ENV=test varlock run -- bun run --filter @haus/computer test
scripts.test:fast: VARLOCK_ENV=test varlock run -- bun test packages scripts apps/website/electron
scripts.test:server: VARLOCK_ENV=test varlock run -- bun run --filter @haus/server test
scripts.test:tracer: cd apps/website && bun x playwright test --config agent-e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:fast && bun run typecheck:licensed
scripts.typecheck:fast: bun run --filter @haus/api typecheck && bun run --filter @haus/sdk typecheck && bun run --filter @haus/claude-usage typecheck && bun run --filter @haus/codex-usage typecheck && bun run --filter @haus/server typecheck
scripts.typecheck:licensed: bun run --filter @haus/website typecheck && bun run --filter @haus/computer typecheck
